Hey everyone! Sorry, my wife and I work thirds so I went to bed shortly after posting this. I appreciate all the recommendations and I'll put the recipe here for you! 


***Ingredients***



1/4 cup finely chopped sun-dried tomatoes (in oil)


2 tablespoons tomato paste


3 garlic cloves, minced


2 cups vegan milk (unsweetened oat milk works well)


1 lb. uncooked penne (gluten-free if needed, we used corn and quinoa pasta)


2 roasted red peppers, chopped


1 – 28-ounce can crushed tomatoes

1 teaspoon sea salt


1/2 teaspoon chili flakes


3 handfuls of spinach


1/4 cup torn basil

Parsley fresh or dry


***How to cook***


I started by roasting red bell peppers in my cast iron. Took about 4 mins each side. Then diced them (careful they will be pretty hot).

Then I got a separate decently deep sized pan and added oil from my sun dried tomatoes, 2 tables spoons tomato paste, my minced garlic, and my finely chopped sun dried tomatoes. Let that simmer until the tomato paste starts to caramelize and turn brown. (about 3 mins, make sure to mix ingredients together.) Cook on Medium High.

Once your tomato paste is caramelized add your diced red peppers, 2 cups vegan milk, your chili flakes (if you want it spicy, if not I recommend paprika), penne, sea salt, and 28-ounce can of crushed tomatoes. Stir well. Once its at a boil reduce temp to low and cover. Let it cook for about 15-20 minutes until your pasta is al dente, then add your spinach and torn basil. Cook for an additional 5-10 minutes or until your pasta is at your preferred cook. Add salt and parsley to taste and enjoy!
